name: Quill
subtitle: Your story, one beat at a time
localizedDescription: Write and organize books at your own pace. Plan chapter beats, generate one beat at a time, edit selected passages with AI, or write everything yourself. Keep a book Codex with summary, plot, style and characters; scan the manuscript for missing context and possible plot holes. Add front and back matter, custom covers, and manage each book’s saved drafts. Includes Apple Intelligence, downloadable writing models and configurable model API connections; local models require compatible hardware, storage and memory, and API providers may charge. Review suggestions before applying them. Backups, folder sync, revision history, Word and EPUB exports. Companion browser app: https://kharrisongit.github.io/Quill/. Install with AltStore Classic.
